lines.en: label ayanespecial2:
scene postrthree1
: Huh?
: Where did Ayane go?
lines.zh: : Ayane 去哪儿了？

lines.en: : If I had to take a guess-
lines.zh: : 非要我猜的话——

lines.en: : I’d assume she was sent back to the beginning.
lines.zh: : 我猜她被送回了起点。

lines.en: scene postrthree2
: The beginning of what?
lines.zh: : 什么的起点？

lines.en: : Everything, obviously.
lines.zh: : 一切，显而易见。

lines.en: : That her mind was “factory restored” the same way it is every time you swap places with another “you.”
lines.zh: : 她的心智被“恢复出厂设置”了，就像每次你跟另一个“你”交换位置时会发生的那样。

lines.en: : Then again, that’s just an assumption.
lines.zh: : 当然，这只是我的假设。

lines.en: : I figure it’s equally probable that she’s just asleep in her dorm room right now- entirely unaware of everything that transpired tonight.
lines.zh: : 我觉得同样有可能的是，她这会儿正睡在宿舍里——对今晚发生的一切一无所知。

lines.en: : And you’re just okay with that?
lines.zh: : 你就这样无所谓吗？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : It’s part of the cycle.
lines.zh: : 这是循环的一部分。

lines.en: : Even if I weren’t “okay with it,” there’s nothing I’d be able to do.
lines.zh: : 就算我“无所谓”不起来，我也无能为力。

lines.en: : Everyone stopped being real to me a long time ago.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，所有人很久以前就不再真实了。

lines.en: : They’re more like puppets with...invisible hands or something inside of them now.
lines.zh: : 他们现在更像是些木偶，里面藏着……看不见的手之类的东西。

lines.en: : I imagine it’s hard to understand given that you’ve only gone through this three times.
lines.zh: : 你才经历过三次，想来是很难理解的。

lines.en: : Well...we need to go check on her then, right?
lines.zh: : 那么……我们得去看看她，对吧？

lines.en: : Is that what you want to do?
lines.zh: : 那是你想做的事吗？

lines.en: : Or would you rather go home and collapse into bed?
lines.zh: : 还是说你更想回家，一头栽进床里？

lines.en: : You should be more worried about this.
lines.zh: : 你应该更担心一点才对。

lines.en: scene postrthree3
: Perhaps I should.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : But have you begun to take into consideration exactly {i}why{/i} Ayane may have made it to the roof tonight?
lines.zh: : 不过你有没有开始想过，Ayane 今晚{i}为什么{/i}会出现在天台上？

lines.en: : I was sort of hoping you would be able to tell me.
lines.zh: : 我还指望你能告诉我呢。

lines.en: : It could be a number of things.
lines.zh: : 原因可能有很多。

lines.en: : But the reason that’s sticking out in my mind the most is so vile that I have an issue with even coming out and saying it.
lines.zh: : 但在我脑子里最突出的那个理由实在太恶心了，我连说出口都有点困难。

lines.en: : What does that-
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思——

lines.en: : It means that you’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 意思就是你很恶心。

lines.en: : Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 你明白吗？

lines.en: : That I’m disgusting?
lines.zh: : 我恶心？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Well...you certainly remind me enough.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你确实没少提醒我这一点。

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : Can you maybe try to be {i}less{/i} disgusting in the future then?
lines.zh: : 那以后你能不能试着{i}别那么{/i}恶心？

lines.en: : Not only for your sake- but for my sake and the sake of everyone else unfortunate enough to become involved with you in any manner other than student and teacher.
lines.zh: : 不只为了你自己——也为了我，为了所有不幸地以师生以外的方式跟你扯上关系的人。

lines.en: : What happened to the Maya from like, an hour ago? The one who laid out a picnic for me?
lines.zh: : 大概一小时前的那个 Maya 去哪儿了？那个给我铺好野餐垫的 Maya？

lines.en: scene postrthree4
: Gone with the reset, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 大概跟着重置一起没了吧。

lines.en: : Also, your blanket is gone.
lines.zh: : 另外，你的毯子也没了。

lines.en: : Sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : Well, I guess we better head back to the dorm.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我想我们该回宿舍了。

lines.en: : It’s not like I really have anywhere else to go anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我也没有别的地方可去。

lines.en: : Maya, if Ayane really {i}is{/i} gone-
lines.zh: : Maya，如果 Ayane {i}真的{/i}就这么没了——

lines.en: scene postrthree3
: You and I will be the only ones to know.
lines.zh: : 那就只有你和我两个人知道。

lines.en: : To everyone else, she’ll be exactly the same as she’s always been.
lines.zh: : 对其他人来说，她会跟往常一模一样。

lines.en: : And any memories that overlap in confusing ways will be rewritten or recontextualized in her mind to make perfect sense to everyone around her.
lines.zh: : 而任何以混乱方式重叠的记忆，都会在她的脑海里被重写、被重新诠释，好让周围所有人都觉得合情合理。

lines.en: : Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 你明白吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不明白。

lines.en: : I didn’t think so.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: scene black
: Now, come.
lines.zh: : 好了，走吧。

lines.en: : If you’re so curious about her wellbeing, it’s probably best for you to find out firsthand exactly what’s happened.
lines.zh: : 既然你这么在意她的安危，最好还是亲自去看看究竟发生了什么。

lines.en: The two of us leave the roof together.
lines.zh: 我们两个人一起离开了天台。

lines.en: As we move through the halls of the[school], I find an assortment of strange items dumped haphazardly onto the stairs and several halls barricaded with boxes.
lines.zh: 我们穿过[school]的走廊时，我发现楼梯上乱七八糟堆着各种奇怪的东西，还有好几条走廊被箱子堵住了。

lines.en: When we make it outside, I notice that the weather has suddenly turned colder than it’s been in quite some time.
lines.zh: 走到室外时，我注意到天气突然变得比前一阵子冷了许多。

lines.en: Maya tightens her scarf and sighs to herself.
lines.zh: Maya 紧了紧围巾，自顾自地叹了口气。

lines.en: I slide my hands into my pockets.
lines.zh: 我把手插进口袋。

lines.en: scene postrthree5
: You can go on ahead.
lines.zh: : 你先走吧。

lines.en: : You’re not coming with me?
lines.zh: : 你不跟我一起？

lines.en: : It’s nearly 3:00 AM. I won’t be as easily forgiven for waking anyone up as you will be.
lines.zh: : 快凌晨三点了。我要是去吵醒谁，可不会像你一样轻易被原谅。

lines.en: : What are you going to do instead, then? Your room is right across the hall from Ayane's.
lines.zh: : 那你打算干什么？你的房间就在 Ayane 房间对面啊。

lines.en: : It appears that we left in such a hurry that I may have forgotten several things in several places.
lines.zh: : 看来我们走得太急，我可能在好几个地方落下好几样东西。

lines.en: : If you’re still here by the time I return, which I truly hope you won’t be, I implore you to ignore my presence entirely and let me sleep.
lines.zh: : 要是我回来的时候你还在这儿——我真心希望你已经走了——求你彻底无视我的存在，让我睡觉。

lines.en: : I am incredibly tired and depressingly frustrated.
lines.zh: : 我累得要命，而且丧气得让人沮丧。

lines.en: : That sounds like more or less how you always are.
lines.zh: : 听起来跟你平时也差不多。

lines.en: : It does, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 确实，不是吗？

lines.en: : Anyway, goodbye.
lines.zh: : 总之，再见。

lines.en: scene postrthree6
Maya blows right by me as if we hadn’t just lost a close friend and restarted the world together.
lines.zh: Maya 径直从我身边擦过，就好像我们刚刚并没有失去一位亲密的朋友、刚刚并没有一起重启世界。

lines.en: I guess it’s possible that she’s just one of those people who internalizes her problems and-
lines.zh: 我想她大概就是那种把问题往心里咽的人，而且——

lines.en: What am I doing?
lines.zh: 我在干什么？

lines.en: I need to go upstairs...
lines.zh: 我得上楼去……

lines.en: scene black
scene postrthree7
I make it to the room despite a pit in my stomach, which I imagine has already begun to sprout roots and transform into a tree, beckoning me to return home instead.
lines.zh: 尽管胃里沉甸甸的——我想那东西大概已经生了根、长成一棵树，在招手叫我回家——我还是走到了房门口。

lines.en: I stand there for what must be a total of five minutes, hoping to hear something- anything on the opposite end.
lines.zh: 我在那儿站了大概足有五分钟，盼着能听见点什么——门那边随便什么动静都好。

lines.en: Of course, it’s the middle of the night right now. And even if Ayane were in there, I doubt she’d be conscious enough to make any noise.
lines.zh: 当然，现在是深夜。就算 Ayane 在里面，我怀疑她也没清醒到能发出什么声音。

lines.en: I knock on the door, hoping that if anyone {i}does{/i} wake up, it’s a resident of this dorm room.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门，祈祷着{i}万一{/i}有人被吵醒，最好是这间宿舍的住客。

lines.en: I might be incredibly popular with all of the girls on this floor (Save Yumi), but even I can’t imagine having an easy time explaining to them exactly why I’m-
lines.zh: 在这层楼的女生里我也许人气高得离谱（Yumi 除外），但就算是我，也很难想象该怎么跟她们解释我为什么——

lines.en: scene postrthree8
: {i}Uaaaahhh~{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}唔啊啊啊~{/i}

lines.en: scene postrthree9
: Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : What are you...doing here?...
lines.zh: : 你……在这儿干什么？……

lines.en: : Hey, Sana. Sorry to wake you up.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sana。抱歉吵醒你了。

lines.en: : It’s okay...
lines.zh: : 没关系……

lines.en: : Did you...need something?
lines.zh: : 你……有什么事吗？

lines.en: : Yes, actually.
lines.zh: : 嗯，还真有。

lines.en: : I was just wondering if Ayane was around.
lines.zh: : 我想知道 Ayane 在不在。

lines.en: : Do you think you could wake her up for me?
lines.zh: : 你能帮我叫醒她吗？

lines.en: : Ayane?...
lines.zh: : Ayane？……

lines.en: : Yeah. I just wanted to make sure she’s okay.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我只是想确认她没事。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: scene postrthree10
: Who is Ayane?...
lines.zh: : Ayane 是谁？……

lines.en: : ...What?
It’s...not possible that she just...disappeared completely, is it?
lines.zh: 她不可能就这么……彻底消失了，对吧？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不可能。

lines.en: No, that can’t be right.
lines.zh: 不，这不可能。

lines.en: Maya didn’t even factor that into any of the possibilities that-
lines.zh: Maya 列出的那些可能性里根本就没有——

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : What are you doing over here this late?
lines.zh: : 这么晚了，你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: scene postrthree11
If I believed in God, I’d thank him right now.
lines.zh: 如果我相信上帝，我现在就要感谢他了。

lines.en: : What are {i}you{/i} doing here this late?
lines.zh: : 这么晚了，{i}你{/i}在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I live here.
lines.zh: : 我住这儿啊。

lines.en: : Yes, but why are you walking around at 3:00 AM? Shouldn’t you be asleep?
lines.zh: : 是，可你为什么凌晨三点还在到处走？你不该在睡觉吗？

lines.en: scene postrthree12
: Sleep is for the weak!
lines.zh: : 睡觉是弱者才做的事！

lines.en: : 3:00 AM is the perfect time for a late night trip to the convenience store when you’re just too strong to sleep!
lines.zh: : 凌晨三点正是深夜跑去便利店的最佳时机，前提是你强到根本睡不着！

lines.en: scene postrthree13
: Nguh...
lines.zh: : 唔呃……

lines.en: : Sensei...you didn’t...wake up Sana just to check on me, did you?
lines.zh: : Sensei……你该不会……是为了确认我没事，才把 Sana 吵醒的吧？

lines.en: : The ideal scenario would have been you answering the door, but yes. It appears that I did wake up Sana to check on you.
lines.zh: : 最理想的情况本来是你来开门，不过没错。看来我确实是为了确认你没事才吵醒了 Sana。

lines.en: scene postrthree14
: And I’m guessing this is the first time you’ve ever seen her immediately after waking up in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 我猜，这应该是你第一次看到她半夜刚被叫醒的样子吧。

lines.en: : Uhh, yes. That is not a thing I have really had the chance to do before.
lines.zh: : 呃，是的。这种事我还真没机会见过。

lines.en: : Well...she can be a little...delusional when that happens.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她那样的时候会有点……神志不清。

lines.en: : She didn’t even remember who you were.
lines.zh: : 她连你是谁都不记得了。

lines.en: : If anything, I’m surprised she {i}did{/i} remember you.
lines.zh: : 要说意外，我倒是挺意外她{i}居然{/i}还记得你。

lines.en: : Sleep...now...
lines.zh: : 睡觉……现在……

lines.en: scene postrthree15
: Yes, Sana. Sleep now.
lines.zh: : 好的，Sana。现在睡觉。

lines.en: : Let’s get you inside...
lines.zh: : 我们先进屋吧……

lines.en: scene black
Ayane gently guides Sana back into the bedroom, leaving her standing in the middle of the floor before sliding off her boots and her skirt.
lines.zh: Ayane 轻轻把 Sana 扶回卧室，让她站在地板中央，然后帮她脱掉靴子和裙子。

lines.en: I notice a small puddle beginning to form near the door as a result of residual snow meeting its demise at the hand of a heated room.
lines.zh: 我注意到门边开始积起一小滩水——残留的雪在有暖气的房间里迎来了它的末日。

lines.en: She returns to Sana and strokes her hair for a moment before leading her to the bed.
lines.zh: 她回到 Sana 身边，抚了一会儿她的头发，然后把她带到床边。

lines.en: If Sana wasn’t mostly unconscious at the moment, it would probably look as if the two of them were getting ready to do something interesting.
lines.zh: 如果 Sana 这会儿不是基本处于无意识状态，她们俩看起来大概就像正准备做点有意思的事。

lines.en: Something that, for some reason, isn’t having the same effect on me that a lesbian fantasy typically would.
lines.zh: 不知为什么，这种画面却没有像通常的女同幻想那样让我起反应。

lines.en: : Sensei, come sit with me for a little while.
lines.zh: : Sensei，过来陪我坐一会儿吧。

lines.en: scene postrthree16
I take a seat beside Ayane and notice, even in this unlit room, two swollen, reddish circles surrounding her eyes.
lines.zh: 我在 Ayane 身边坐下，即使在这间没有开灯的房间里，也能看到她眼睛周围两圈红肿发红的痕迹。

lines.en: If I ask her now what caused them, she’ll deflect.
lines.zh: 如果我现在问她是怎么弄的，她一定会岔开话题。

lines.en: The same way she does every time I ask her anything.
lines.zh: 就像每次我问她任何问题时一样。

lines.en: Even when we were on the roof, when she was doing everything she could to pour a tiny bit of her heart out-
lines.zh: 就算刚才在天台上，她已经拼尽全力地掏出了一点点真心——

lines.en: : The roof...
lines.zh: : 天台……

lines.en: : The roof?
lines.zh: : 天台？

lines.en: : What roof?
lines.zh: : 什么天台？

lines.en: : Ayane, where were you tonight?
lines.zh: : Ayane，你今晚去哪儿了？

lines.en: : What are you talking about? I was with you, remember?
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？我一直跟你在一起啊，你不记得了？

lines.en: : I was being weird and kept trying to talk about stuff that...didn’t really come out the way I wanted it to.
lines.zh: : 我当时怪怪的，一直在试着说一些……最后没能按我想要的方式说出口的事。

lines.en: : And where was Sana?
lines.zh: : 那 Sana 在哪儿？

lines.en: : Wasn’t she just here?
lines.zh: : 她刚刚不是还在这儿吗？

lines.en: : No, she was at my house.
lines.zh: : 不，她在我家。

lines.en: scene postrthree17
: Sana was?
lines.zh: : Sana 在我家？

lines.en: : And Ami. And Molly. And Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 还有 Ami。还有 Molly。还有 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : There was a sleepover that you were supposed to come to, but you decided against it because you wanted to talk to me instead.
lines.zh: : 本来有一场睡衣派对，你也该来的，可你决定不去，因为你想跟我谈谈。

lines.en: : Why would I ever turn down a sleepover? I love sleepovers.
lines.zh: : 我怎么会拒绝睡衣派对？我最爱睡衣派对了。

lines.en: : Couldn’t I have just talked to you-
lines.zh: : 我难道不能就在那儿跟你说——

lines.en: scene postrthree18
: Actually...I probably couldn’t have talked to you at your house since there was all that stuff about Ami.
lines.zh: : 其实……在你家我大概确实没法跟你说，毕竟还有 Ami 那些事。

lines.en: : But...I don’t remember anything about a sleepover.
lines.zh: : 可是……我完全不记得有什么睡衣派对。

lines.en: : And I can’t really figure out why Sana would be here if there actually {i}was{/i} one.
lines.zh: : 而且如果{i}真有{/i}那么一场派对，我也搞不懂 Sana 为什么会在这儿。

lines.en: So-
lines.zh: 所以——

lines.en: It looks like Ayane hasn’t been completely “factory restored.”
lines.zh: 看来 Ayane 并没有被彻底“恢复出厂设置”。

lines.en: But...I’m not understanding why it’s suddenly as if the last day has just been entirely rewritten.
lines.zh: 可是……我不明白为什么突然之间，过去这一整天就像被整个重写了一样。

lines.en: And it’s not like I can even ask Maya about it since she is mad at me for yet another reason beyond my comprehension.
lines.zh: 而且我也没法去问 Maya，她正因为我无法理解的又一个理由在生我的气。

lines.en: But where do Ayane’s memories end?
lines.zh: 可 Ayane 的记忆到底断在哪里？

lines.en: Why can she recollect her first trip to the roof, but not her second? And-
lines.zh: 为什么她记得第一次上天台，却不记得第二次？而且——

lines.en: Wait, didn’t she say “What roof?”
lines.zh: 等等，她刚才是不是说了“什么天台？”

lines.en: : Ayane, where did we meet up tonight?
lines.zh: : Ayane，我们今晚在哪儿碰的面？

lines.en: scene postrthree19
: Sensei...is everything okay? You’re acting really weird...
lines.zh: : Sensei……你还好吗？你这样子好奇怪……

lines.en: : Just tell me where we met tonight.
lines.zh: : 你就告诉我我们今晚在哪儿见的面。

lines.en: : We met at the same park we went to with Sana the other day.
lines.zh: : 就在前几天跟 Sana 一起去的那个公园啊。

lines.en: : And we talked about Ami and...and your memories and...
lines.zh: : 我们聊了 Ami，还有……还有你的记忆，还有……

lines.en: : Is this...another example of that?
lines.zh: : 这……又是那种情况吗？

lines.en: : Are you...misremembering, maybe?
lines.zh: : 是你……记错了，也许？

lines.en: : I didn’t realize it was this bad...
lines.zh: : 我不知道已经严重到这种地步了……

lines.en: I’m not the one misremembering anything this time.
lines.zh: 这次记错的人不是我。

lines.en: It’s you.
lines.zh: 是你。

lines.en: You’re the one who forgot.
lines.zh: 忘掉的人是你。

lines.en: : We met on the roof of the[school].
lines.zh: : 我们是在[school]的天台上见面的。

lines.en: : I don’t even have a key to the roof of the[school]...
lines.zh: : 我连[school]天台的钥匙都没有啊……

lines.en: : That’s-
Wait...
lines.zh: 等等……

lines.en: Yeah.
lines.zh: 对啊。

lines.en: How did we meet there anyway?
lines.zh: 我们到底是怎么在那儿见上面的？

lines.en: : This next part might make me sound a little crazy, but I need you to listen closely and answer as honestly as possible.
lines.zh: : 接下来这话可能会让我听起来有点疯，但你要仔细听，尽量诚实地回答我。

lines.en: : Sure...yeah. Anything for you.
lines.zh: : 好……嗯。为了你什么都行。

lines.en: : By any chance, do you remember {i}anything{/i} about going to the roof with Maya tonight? And...resetting the world and...anything like that?
lines.zh: : 你{i}还记不记得{/i}今晚跟 Maya 一起上天台的事？还有……重置世界……之类的事？

lines.en: scene postrthree20
We let the silence overtake us for a moment.
lines.zh: 我们让沉默笼罩了自己片刻。

lines.en: It’s hard to tell if Ayane is genuinely trying to remember or just...trying to figure out if I need immediate medical attention, but...
lines.zh: 很难说 Ayane 是真的在努力回忆，还是只是在……判断我是不是需要马上送医，不过……

lines.en: Whatever the cause for the silence is-
lines.zh: 不管这沉默的原因是什么——

lines.en: I hate it.
lines.zh: 我讨厌它。

lines.en: : I don’t remember anything like that...
lines.zh: : 我不记得有那种事……

lines.en: : All I remember is that I called you to meet up...and then we did...and then I went home.
lines.zh: : 我只记得我叫你出来见面……然后我们见了……然后我就回家了。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : But that doesn’t explain why you were walking around at 3:00 AM with dark, red circles around your eyes.
lines.zh: : 可这解释不了你为什么凌晨三点还在到处走，眼睛周围还有那么深的红圈。

lines.en: : And I don’t buy that whole “sleep is for the weak” thing.
lines.zh: : 而且“睡觉是弱者才做的事”那套我根本不信。

lines.en: : What else happened?
lines.zh: : 还发生了什么？

lines.en: scene postrthree21
: What else?...
lines.zh: : 还发生了什么？……

lines.en: : I guess it’s my turn to sound a little crazy then, huh?...
lines.zh: : 那这回轮到我来说点疯话了，是吧？……

lines.en: : The truth is...I tried to sleep, but...
lines.zh: : 其实……我试着睡了，可是……

lines.en: : But I had this really weird dream.
lines.zh: : 可是我做了一个很奇怪的梦。

lines.en: : A dream that I...can’t quite remember anymore.
lines.zh: : 一个我……已经记不太清的梦。

lines.en: : And...when I woke up...
lines.zh: : 然后……我醒来的时候……

lines.en: : I felt like I’d lost something.
lines.zh: : 感觉自己失去了什么。

lines.en: scene postrthree22
: Something really, really important to me and...and I couldn’t even put my finger on what it was.
lines.zh: : 对我来说非常非常重要的东西，而我……我甚至说不出那到底是什么。

lines.en: : Which made me kind of hate myself a little bit.
lines.zh: : 这让我有点恨自己。

lines.en: : Like there was some really big thing that was just...stripped from my mind as if it never even existed...
lines.zh: : 就好像有什么天大的事，就这么……从我脑子里被抽走了，仿佛它从来没存在过……

lines.en: : If it was so important, how come I forgot it so easily?
lines.zh: : 如果它那么重要，我怎么会忘得这么轻而易举？

lines.en: : None of it made sense...
lines.zh: : 一切都讲不通……

lines.en: : And...I didn’t want to call you about it since I already bothered you enough tonight...
lines.zh: : 而且……我不想为这事打电话给你，因为今晚我已经够烦你了……

lines.en: : But...the fact that you’re back before the sun comes up kinda shows me that...maybe I didn’t bother you as much as I thought I did...
lines.zh: : 可是……你在太阳升起之前又跑回来这件事，好像在告诉我……也许我没有我以为的那么烦人……

lines.en: scene postrthree23
: Do you think this is what I was talking about when I told you I’d need a little more attention soon?
lines.zh: : 你觉得，这就是我跟你说的“很快会需要你多关心我一点”那件事吗？

lines.en: : I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道。

lines.en: : Yeah...and it's kind of funny cause, like...
lines.zh: : 是啊……而且有点好笑，因为……

lines.en: : Neither do I...
lines.zh: : 我也不知道……

lines.en: : I’m...really confused all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 我……突然好混乱……

lines.en: : My stomach kind of hurts a little too...
lines.zh: : 肚子也隐隐有点疼……

lines.en: : Is this anxiety? Do I have anxiety now?
lines.zh: : 这就是焦虑吗？我现在是焦虑了吗？

lines.en: : I highly doubt it. You probably just need to get some rest.
lines.zh: : 我很怀疑。你大概只是需要休息。

lines.en: : How am I supposed to rest when you came all the way here to see me, though?
lines.zh: : 可你都特意跑来看我了，我怎么还睡得着？

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be right for me to just kick you out when you're this worried.
lines.zh: : 你这么担心我，我却把你赶走，那也太说不过去了。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: scene postrthree24
: Do you wanna at least have sex first?
lines.zh: : 那至少先做一次吧？

lines.en: : I’d feel a little better about going to sleep if I gave you a little reminder to take with you when you go.
lines.zh: : 要是能让你带点“纪念”走，我睡着的时候会好受一点。

lines.en: : Sana is literally asleep on your lap right now.
lines.zh: : Sana 现在就睡在你腿上啊。

lines.en: : She won’t wake up. It’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 她不会醒的。没问题的。

lines.en: : She woke up after one knock on the door. It won’t be fine.
lines.zh: : 她敲一下门就醒了。不会没问题的。

lines.en: : Besides, I can’t touch you while you’re crying anyway. That’s one of the rules on my...incredibly short list of them.
lines.zh: : 再说，你哭的时候我本来就碰不了你。这是我那张……短得可怜的规矩清单上的一条。

lines.en: scene postrthree25
: Okay, okay. We won’t have sex.
lines.zh: : 好好好。那就不做。

lines.en: : But I owe you at least one blowjob in the future as payment for coming to make sure I was okay tonight.
lines.zh: : 不过为了报答你今晚特意跑来确认我没事，我以后至少欠你一次口活。

lines.en: : I still don’t really know what it is that made me cry like this, but I’m sure it’ll be okay soon enough.
lines.zh: : 我还是不知道到底是什么让我哭成这样，不过我肯定很快就会没事的。

lines.en: : I probably just need some sleep like you said.
lines.zh: : 大概就像你说的，我只是需要睡一觉。

lines.en: : Then...I guess I’ll go home, then.
lines.zh: : 那……我想我该回家了。

lines.en: scene postrthree26
: Are you sure you don’t want to sleep here?
lines.zh: : 你真的不要在这儿睡吗？

lines.en: : My bed is huge. All three of us could fit if we snuggled a little bit.
lines.zh: : 我的床很大。我们三个挤一挤也睡得下。

lines.en: : Maybe some other night. I’m kind of curious about whether anyone else from the apparent “made up slumber party” is still at my house or not.
lines.zh: : 改天吧。我有点好奇，那场“凭空冒出来的睡衣派对”里还有没有别人留在我家。

lines.en: : Well, if they are, feel free to give me a call. I don’t wanna miss out on the fun even if it’s almost time for[school].
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果她们还在，随时打电话给我。就算快到[school]的时间了，我也不想错过好玩的事。

lines.en: : Oh, shit. School.
lines.zh: : 哦，操。学校。

lines.en: : I didn’t even realize it was Sunday.
lines.zh: : 我都没意识到今天是周日。

lines.en: : On the bright side, I doubt you had any tests planned or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，我猜你也没安排什么考试之类的吧。

lines.en: : Jokes on you, Ayane. Tomorrow is the day I’m going to become a real teacher.
lines.zh: : 你失算了，Ayane。明天就是我成为一名真正的老师的日子。

lines.en: : Well, {i}today{/i} technically, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好吧，严格说来是{i}今天{/i}。

lines.en: : Whatever you decide to do, I'll support it.
lines.zh: : 不管你决定怎么做，我都支持你。

lines.en: : I love you, Sensei. And thank you for coming to see me again tonight.
lines.zh: : 我爱你，Sensei。谢谢你今晚又来看我。

lines.en: : I feel a lot better now...
lines.zh: : 我现在好受多了……

lines.en: scene black
I leave shortly after that.
lines.zh: 之后没多久我就离开了。

lines.en: I don’t understand anything at all.
lines.zh: 我什么都搞不明白。

lines.en: What happened this weekend?
lines.zh: 这个周末到底发生了什么？

lines.en: Why did Ayane show up to the roof? And why did she immediately forget it?
lines.zh: Ayane 为什么会出现在天台？为什么她转头就忘了？

lines.en: This isn’t even resetting.
lines.zh: 这甚至根本不是重置。

lines.en: It’s rewriting things that {i}did{/i} happen with things that didn’t.
lines.zh: 这是拿没发生过的事，去改写{i}发生过{/i}的事。

lines.en: If they even...did happen?
lines.zh: 如果那些事……真的发生过的话？

lines.en: I don’t know anymore.
lines.zh: 我已经不知道了。

lines.en: Not that I ever did, but-
lines.zh: 虽然我从来就没知道过，不过——

lines.en: But at least I’m still here.
lines.zh: 但至少我还在这儿。

lines.en: And I guess that’s really the most important thing of all right now.
lines.zh: 我想，这大概才是眼下最重要的事。

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: I feel like I may have lost something too.
lines.zh: 感觉我自己好像也失去了什么。
